notes.title: Trading cards are RELEASED!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone,
It finally happened, Trading Cards are now available in Horny Sekai![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/43b97780e8f856ee40bc9627a4d1498928b6cef7.png[/img]

[h2]We've added absolutely adorable emotions that you can use in chat! 
And beautiful backgrounds with animated versions of them[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/09fce6ba3426554ef9542f46fe9dcf5c05ae7afa.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/ac8992d3d971b0529bb033df8f6ddf314dd8e734.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/1f157f737c321d44a6552076a9524bfb7604c38a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/4f07decb6a7ccc78b45baa260eafa8b0a6d4e0cd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/b0c7d9f729e8fddbac7eedba14a9e2e176bb7b77.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/16cddb5f5220b02db89232e410666e3ebc289889.jpg[/img]

[h1]Soon, we will also be releasing a public demo of our next game “Horny Warp” so add it to your wishlist to try it out for free[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1539160/Horny_Warp/

[h2]Have fun![/h2]

notes.title: Update & News!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/67661163a59ed8bda02396ea928b7e0ad2ffe79f.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b] [/h1]

[h2]First of all - thank you for your feedback! 

After reading every review and community message we decided to do those changes:[/h2]

[h3][b]- Every fight counts[/b]
If you lost before because of a big amount of enemies and lost all your money - now you won't!

[b]- Tutorial[/b]
We decided that it will be easier to play the game with a tutorial

[b]- Big optimization work![/b]
Some PCs were a little bit overwhelmed mid-fight, so now it reworked and won't lag

[b]- DLC changes[/b]
For the DLC we reworked sounds, made some bugfixes, and made animations a little bit smoother.[/h3]

[h3][b]I hope you will like those changes and you will like the game even better![/b][/h3]

[h2]And we also have news! We started a new project: [b]Horny warp![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1539160/Horny_Warp

[h2]If you are interested in it you can also support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/IlluminatiGames]Patreon[/url]! We will post arts, animations, and test builds there![/h2]

notes.title: Battle update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40689928/c114eb7414c496a41da097f7a7c8ad53107d0180.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b] [/h1]

[h2]I received a lot of thoughts from you regarding the minigame. 
Thank you all for your feedback! 
So to improve everyone's experience, I have decided to introduce some new features, here they are:[/h2]

[h2][b]- the mob you are currently attacking is now highlighted with a glow

- you will now be able to buy more items (x1,5 reward)

- easy difficulty is really easy now (mobs' HP is decreased on easy)[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]I hope those changes will make you enjoy playing minigame more! And as always - your feedback is very much appreciated! It really helps me to improve the game![/b][/h3]
